title: Queue-flake anchor: packages/fields FilterConditionField.betweenBlankBound-9914.test.tsx:174 — toHaveValue(5) receives "5" (render race before the schema types the field)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (6961296270). This is a queue-flake anchor.

- **Ejected:** PR #34955 (#34818 slice 3) from merge-queue build 44173515593. The PR does not touch `packages/fields`.
- **Where:** Test UI shard 11/16, `FilterConditionField.betweenBlankBound-9914.test.tsx:174`: `toHaveValue(5)` received the string `"5"`.
- **Reading** (PR comment 6961223962, #34818 comment 6961242308): the `To` box is queried before the async object schema has typed `age` as a number, which is a render race. The same queue commit 471a3da09 passes the file 3 of 3 times locally.
- **Fix shape:** wait for the schema-typed render (`findBy`, or wait for the number input) before the assertion.

Grade: **p2 · domain:ui**, under the queue-flake rule (#34152): one independent root, one head, so p2 and no jump. It is raised to p0 if a second head is ejected by it.
